why: The El-Ahmar house is a small one-storey family home on the Rancho Coronado side of Santo Domingo, with a porch, a front room and a kitchen, home to Gloria El-Ahmar and her family. Vanilla loads it almost only for the Sinnerman follow-up (Joshua Stephenson's visit), which also switches on its three shard pickups and force-locks the front door. This proposal restores the house as a home: Gloria and Mariah present at their own porch/yard workspots and the house shards visible, with the front door left to the runtime door policy.

open_questions: Vanilla never Activate's #sq023_com_glorias_house, only Deactivates it; whole-set Activate should put gloria at gloria_start and mariah at albums, but confirm both appear and that neither stands in an odd spot (their workspots are generic stand-ground wait poses at the porch).
Whether the three house shards (var_sq023_gh_shards=1) are wanted permanently: they are the family's lore pickups but vanilla shows them only during the visit scene.
Zuleikha lives here per the wiki but has no spawn entry; decide whether the cast layer should add her separately.
The front door's cooked lock/authorization state is unknown (device props were not extracted); the door policy is the assumed way in.

spawn_sets.why: The house community has exactly two entries, gloria (Character.sq023_gloria) and mariah (Character.sq023_mariah), i.e. the residents and nobody else. Activating the whole set puts them at their initial phases, gloria_start and albums, which are generic stand-ground wait workspots on the porch/yard a metre apart - a relaxed, idle pair at home, not a quest pose. Vanilla only ever deactivates this set (once for the visit scene, once when the group drives to the restaurant), so the activation is ours and needs a tour check.

variant_toggles.why: Shows the house's three data shards (#sq023_gh_shard_01..03), which the house phase switches on so the family's records are readable while V is at the door. Hidden is the variant default, so without this the home reads as stripped; 1 is vanilla's own house state and the only value the phase ever sets.

proximity_wait.why: The house's own front-door device, the only device vanilla drives at this venue: a DoorControllerPS at the front entrance that the house phase force-closes and force-locks, so it is exactly the entity that streams in when a player walks up to the house.
